item.title: No left turn at Chelsea Bridge in London
item.description: This junction near Chelsea Bridge now has no left turns allowed, improving cyclist safety. Buses have been rerouted to avoid them crossing the marked cycle lane, which is lightly protected by wands after the junction in the video.
